sections.Intro: This remedy is indicated in cases of digestive and respiratory disorders. It is useful in cases of dyspepsia and chronic cough. The patient is often a great meat-eater. There is a general feeling of heaviness and fullness.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo.
sections.Mouth: Profuse salivation. Tongue pale and flabby. Garlic-like breath.
sections.Throat: Sensation of a hair in the throat. Swollen and sore.
sections.Stomach: Increased appetite. Thirst. Heaviness and pressure after eating. Burning eructations.
sections.Abdomen: Distended with gas. Flatulence. Sharp pains in the region of the liver.
sections.Rectum: Diarrhoea of thin, watery stools. Prolapse of the rectum.
sections.Respiratory: Violent cough, with bloody expectoration. Shortness of breath on motion.
